title: Drive-In: Server
description: The EC2 host, Caddy at the edge, PostgreSQL, backups and the monitoring stack itself.

panels.title: Backup age (pg_dump)
panels.description: Time since the nightly pg_dump to S3 last succeeded (backup.sh records it).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: t4g.small earns credits for 20% average use; sustained use above that is billed (a CloudWatch alarm watches).

panels.title: Pressure (time stalled)
panels.description: Share of time some task waited for CPU, memory or I/O (Linux PSI). Memory pressure means the box is swapping.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Every request Caddy served: the app, Grafana and redirects.

panels.title: Latency at the edge
panels.description: Includes Blazor's long-lived WebSocket requests, which stretch the upper percentiles.

panels.title: 5xx at the edge
panels.description: 502/503/504 here mostly mean the app container is down or restarting.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Open requests, including Blazor circuits' WebSockets: roughly the people using the app right now.
